protocol.colour: Float sRGB [0,1], Lab D65, CIEDE2000 mean pixels
protocol.lpips: LPIPS v0.1 SqueezeNet, pretrained ImageNet backbone, input [-1,1]
protocol.aggregation: Arithmetic mean per patch; also report scene means
protocol.target: Clean RAW rendered through fixed approximate camera transform; not captured RGB ground truth
protocol.context: All methods receive the same 4-pixel RAW border; network outputs are cropped to the central target
protocol.stress: Synthetic degradations; target remains original clean render; not a separate real-capture benchmark

limitations: Only two fresh final scenes; not official benchmark ranking
Approximate colour calibration; Delta E measures the supplied target rendering
Team identity and public hosting are separate submission steps
